                "options": xhatlooper_options,
                "all_scenario_names": scenario_names,
                "scenario_creator": scenario_creator,
                "scenario_creator_kwargs": scenario_creator_kwargs,
                "scenario_denouement": denouement,
                "all_nodenames": nodenames,
            },
        }

    wheel = WheelSpinner(hub_dict=hub_dict, spokes_dict=spokes_dict)
    wheel.spin()

    print(f"Best Inner Bound: {wheel.best_inner_bound}")

        write_spin_the_wheel_tree_solution(wheel, cfg.output_prefix)

if __name__ == "__main__":
